notes.title: Patch notes 08.10.2025
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I hope you are all doing well

Bug fixes:

fixed camera clipping into arms when setting fov to high

fixed wrong scope location for the sniper rifle when picked up

fixed ui acting strange on player death

fixed various ui bugs

fixed some other stuff I forgot to mention



Added:

Added "Known Bugs" tab on the main menu for easier bug reporting/tracking

Other various performance / visual improvements



There are still some bugs left I'm aware of, and I'm working on them. I wanted to release this update to see if this build breaks anything. Also, a new map is coming, probably next update.



Cheers :)

notes.title: Update July 18
notes.content:
** Note: At the moment, I'm running a private playtest. Public playtest will roll out soon **

Some vfx and model changes, bug fixes, and minor performance improvements

notes.title: Patch Notes Oct. 09
notes.content:
This is the first update since the release of Like Birds :) As I promised, I will keep updating bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

* Fixed camera clipping in certain situations
* Helicopter arrives sooner
* Stuttering in certain situation should be fixed/improved
* Moved climbable pipe to a more visible location, so players can find where to go easier
* Other fixes/improvements

Other than continuously working on fixes and updates, I'm currently working on a Linux port. I've already found out that the game runs without any issues with proton on the latest version of Linux mint, but I would like to make an official build.

Thank you.
